acceptance.boundaryGate: For every viewport and clip plane, all eight independently selected ramp slopes must equal the same-size safe translation if and only if the tested outer edge is inclusively inside the frozen NDC +/-1.5 candidate.
acceptance.integrityGate: Every preregistered record must be written exactly at its expected case and pixel index, primitive IDs must be 0 or 1, and every captured floating-point word must be finite.
acceptance.topologyGate: Every grid sample must retain builtin barycentrics, one-hot no-perspective basis center and pull values, eight X/Y ramp pull pairs, and its source primitive ID. Topology observations are discovery evidence and cannot validate a fitted model in this run.

interventions.boundary: Each left, right, top, and bottom outer edge is translated independently over half a viewport at one-pixel spacing, with every 1/256-pixel phase included within one pixel of the candidate. Geometry span and all varying endpoint bits remain fixed within a group.
interventions.boundaryControls: Each group includes a same-size safe translation one eighth of a viewport outside the API viewport but inside the candidate guard region. Two independent same-tile 30-pixel baselines recover each slope without sharing a plane constant across tiles or source triangles.
interventions.topology: Thirty-seven rectangles cross isolated X, isolated Y, combined XY, coordinate-phase, size, and viewport-scale conditions. A four-pixel interior grid records original primitive identity, builtin barycentrics, one-hot basis planes, and eight fresh centered X/Y ramps.
interventions.viewportScale: The complete four-plane experiment is independently repeated at power-of-two 256- and 512-pixel viewports so a normalized clip boundary is distinguishable from a fixed screen-space margin without introducing non-power-of-two viewport-transform rounding.

limitations.reason: This discovery run can establish the clip boundary and expose generated topology. Any arithmetic law derived from those observations requires a later frozen held-out image gate.
